scope: Formatting-only candidate for accepted herbert-fitzroy-family-01. No link re-adjudication, accepted mutation or export.
method: Used accepted group provenance and direct preserved source HTML. Requirements target actual feature-bearing text, dates, headers, embedded quotations, MathML/fractions, enclosures and voice boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the multipart voyage body and its receipt/endorsement claims as separate dated sections.

evidence.quote: I am writing this on the 8th of February

requirements.notes: Do not infer an endorsement or receipt beyond the body’s explicit wording.

requirements.requirement: Keep the concert programme and continuation date in the authorial Somerville correspondence; preserve the name attribution error as source evidence.

evidence.quote: writing a short letter to a distant friend is like making an old acquaintance a distant bow

requirements.notes: The programme/date continuation and Somerville naming are source layers, not editorial corrections.

requirements.requirement: Render the body’s MathML fractions literally and keep the received-letter acknowledgement separate from later voyage context.
requirements.notes: Fractions occur in the same authorial body; receipt is explicit but exact delivery timing is not.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the crossing discussion and the authorial date continuation without importing later biological interpretation.

evidence.quote: I have now taken up a permanent abode at Chester

requirements.notes: The source’s discussion of crossing remains Herbert’s voice.

requirements.requirement: Keep the quoted satirical plant-graft passage as embedded quotation, distinct from Darwin’s surrounding response.

evidence.quote: I received your letter, dated December 1st.

requirements.notes: Quoted third-party satire must not be flattened into Darwin voice.

requirements.requirement: Render MathML 1/2 and preserve the possible Quellota copyist/wrapping uncertainty.

evidence.quote: I arrived at this gay city late last night

requirements.notes: The fraction and copyist/wrapping evidence require source-layer preservation, not silent normalization.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the navigation instruction “Go to 1st page” as body text and distinguish it from header/address material.
requirements.notes: This is a document-navigation instruction, not a historical date or scientific claim.

requirements.requirement: Keep the quotation of the missing letter and its postscript order explicit; do not reconstruct the missing original.

evidence.quote: Two hours since, I received your epistle, dated 26th.

requirements.notes: The responder’s quotation and PS order are separate from the absent Darwin letter.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the authorial wrong address exactly and do not treat it as a recipient identity change.

evidence.quote: Welcome, right welcome, was the sight of that good round unmistakeable hand of yours

requirements.notes: The wrong address 9 Old Square Lincoln’s Inn is in the opener/header and must be preserved separately; it is not body voice.

requirements.requirement: Mark the accompanying agreement enclosure as absent/unread and retain only the surviving proposal text.

evidence.quote: He recommended a joint publication such as is sketched in the accompanying paper

requirements.notes: The referenced agreement is not a recovered enclosure; no terms may be invented.

source_pins.quote: I am writing this on the 8th of February
writing a short letter to a distant friend is like making an old acquaintance a distant bow
I have now taken up a permanent abode at Chester
I received your letter, dated December 1st.
I arrived at this gay city late last night
Two hours since, I received your epistle, dated 26th.
He recommended a joint publication such as is sketched in the accompanying paper

recommendations: Keep multipart dates, headers, quoted material, enclosures and authorial voices in separate layers.
Render supported MathML literally; hold copyist/wrapping uncertainty, missing enclosures and unresolved quoted originals.
Do not infer receipt, identity or agreement contents from address, dispatch or catalogue context.
